missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Состав' is masculine and stays in the nominative as the subject of 'изменился'. 'Команды' is genitive showing whose lineup it is.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Состав' is inanimate masculine, so its accusative matches the nominative as the object of 'объявил'. 'Новый' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive object. 'Состава' is genitive after the negated verb 'не знаем'. 'Лекарства' is genitive showing whose composition it is.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Составу' is dative after 'удивились', which governs the dative. 'Почвы' is genitive marking whose composition it is.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Составе' is prepositional after 'о', marking the topic of the request. 'Продукта' is genitive showing whose composition it is.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Составом' is instrumental after 'довольны', a short adjective that governs that case. 'Группы' is genitive showing whose lineup it is.
Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Состав' is accusative after 'в', a fixed pattern with 'входят'. The accusative matches the nominative for this inanimate noun.

missions.phrase: Это вещество входит в состав воды.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Accusative after preposition. 'Состав' is accusative after 'в' with 'входит'. 'Воды' is genitive marking whose composition it forms part of.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Составе' is prepositional after 'в' in the fixed phrase 'в полном составе', meaning at full strength. 'Полном' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Составы' is the nominative plural subject of 'стоят', here meaning train sets. 'Разные' agrees in the plural, and 'поездов' is genitive plural.
